mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate indicates monetary easing that reduces discount rates and boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in sustained FEDFUNDS decline periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 5.0% in a 3-month window, it signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 60% of triggered instances (UNRATE > 5.0% for 3 months), or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) both decline in the same month, it indicates synchronized demand and supply contraction that reduces aggregate economic activity and corporate profits, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 60% of instances where both HOUST and INDPRO decline, or interaction signal Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening regime (FEDFUNDS > 5.0%), the Federal Reserve's policy stance reduces liquidity and increases borrowing costs, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 5.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicates labor market strength that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in sustained PAYEMS growth periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1200 thousand units, it signals housing market contraction that reduces consumer wealth and business investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 60% of triggered instances (HOUST < 1200), or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a manufacturing slowdown regime (INDPRO growth rate < 0.5% annually), industrial production contraction reduces corporate output and profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 60% of instances where INDPRO growth rate < 0.5% annually, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When annualized consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) rises above 2.5%, it signals accelerating inflation that prompts Federal Reserve tightening, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in < 60% of triggered instances (CPIAUCSL > 2.5% annually), or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
